name: SimplePractice Note Taker
one_liner: AI-powered session notes for SimplePractice Telehealth users
short_description: SimplePractice Note Taker is an AI scribe add-on for SimplePractice that automatically generates therapy notes from telehealth sessions. Priced at $35/month per clinician, it supports SOAP, DAP,...
long_description:
SimplePractice Note Taker is an AI-powered documentation tool designed exclusively for mental health clinicians using SimplePractice. The feature automatically transcribes and generates structured clinical notes from telehealth sessions conducted through SimplePractice's built-in video platform.

The Note Taker supports multiple therapy note formats including SOAP, DAP, and BIRP, allowing clinicians to choose the structure that best fits their documentation style and payer requirements. Notes are generated after sessions and can be reviewed and edited before being finalized in the patient's chart.

As a native SimplePractice feature, Note Taker is tightly integrated with the practice management platform. There's no separate login or external tool to manage—generated notes flow directly into patient records. The service is HITRUST certified and covered under SimplePractice's existing BAA.

Key limitation: Note Taker only works with SimplePractice Telehealth sessions. It cannot transcribe in-person sessions, phone calls, or sessions conducted through other video platforms. Clinicians who see patients in-person or use external telehealth tools will need a different AI scribe solution for those encounters.

faqs.q: How much does SimplePractice Note Taker cost?
faqs.a: SimplePractice Note Taker costs $35 per clinician per month as an add-on to your existing SimplePractice subscription.

faqs.q: What note formats does Note Taker support?
faqs.a: SimplePractice Note Taker generates notes in SOAP, DAP, and BIRP formats, allowing therapists to choose the structure that fits their documentation preferences and payer requirements.

faqs.q: Does Note Taker work with in-person sessions?
faqs.a: No, SimplePractice Note Taker only works with sessions conducted through SimplePractice Telehealth. It cannot transcribe in-person sessions, phone calls, or sessions using other video platforms.

faqs.q: Is SimplePractice Note Taker HIPAA compliant?
faqs.a: Yes, Note Taker is HIPAA compliant and HITRUST certified. It's covered under SimplePractice's existing Business Associate Agreement.
